IGUI_PZRC_NoteText: If you're reading this, you're still alive. That's already a good sign. A handful of stubborn folks have dug in among the ruins and are still holding on. Not paradise, but somewhere you can catch your breath and meet the living. Coordinates: %1, %2. Find a radio - you can rig one from scraps - and tune it to %3 MHz. That's our channel. Listen for what's stirring out there and where it's worth heading before anyone else gets there. Move careful. These streets aren't for the living anymore.
